description: This file defines an interface 'VoicemailProviderHelper' that provides methods for manipulating voicemails within a voicemail content provider in an Android application. It includes method signatures for inserting, updating, deleting, and retrieving voicemails, as well as setting voicemail content from streams or byte arrays.

classes.name: VoicemailProviderHelper
classes.description: An interface that provides methods for managing voicemails in the content provider, including insert, delete, update, and query operations.

classes.name: SortOrder
classes.description: An enum defining sorting options (ASCENDING, DESCENDING, DEFAULT) for retrieving voicemails.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all voicemails accessible to the content provider, returning the number of deleted entries.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new voicemail into the content provider, returning the URI of the inserted voicemail.

methods.name: findVoicemailBySourceData
methods.description: Retrieves a Voicemail object matching the given source data; returns null if none found.

methods.name: findVoicemailByUri
methods.description: Retrieves a Voicemail object corresponding to the specified URI; returns null if not found.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing voicemail with the data from the provided Voicemail object.

methods.name: setVoicemailContent
methods.description: Sets the voicemail content from an InputStream or byte array, associated with a specific voicemail URI.

methods.name: getAllVoicemails
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all voicemails accessible to the provider.

methods.name: getAllVoicemails with filter
methods.description: Retrieves and sorts voicemails based on the provided filter, sort column, and sort order.

methods.name: getUriForVoicemailWithId
methods.description: Returns the URI for the voicemail with the specified message ID.
